description: Eric Zimmerman's Get-ZimmermanTools: PowerShell downloader and updater for his forensic tools.
notes: The shim passes -NoUpdate so Scoop, rather than the script, manages updates.
Use -Dest to save the downloaded tools outside the Scoop installation directory.
The upstream site does not publish a static SHA256 checksum for this archive. The manifest omits hash; Scoop may warn until a hash is populated.

script: if (-not $match.Success) { throw 'Could not read the upstream script update date.' }
